ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields covering the central and lateral lobes; high-contrast black pigmentation concentrated at the insertion point (peduncle area) and extending upward towards the median notch; dark fringe along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; scattered dark circular and elliptical mottling across both white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the medial trailing edge, transition to higher-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a steep upward sweep; trailing edges exhibit a slight concave curvature near the notch transitioning to convex towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment scars) distributed across the white field, notably one distinct spot on the mid-left lobe and two on the upper-mid right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, dark diagonal linear disruption visible on the lower-left lobe; several fine, horizontal grey-scale marks observed on the interior right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and jagged tissue loss on the far distal tip of the right lobe (image-right).
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, isolated dark pigment 'island' located on the interior edge of the right lobe, adjacent to the black pigmentation of the notch area.
